articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: ASX Growth Leaders With Strong Insider Confidence. As the Australian market approaches the holiday season with a slight dip, largely due to profit-taking and external influences from Wall Street's highs, investors are keenly observing sectors like precious metals that have recently shown strength. In this environment, growth companies with high insider ownership can be particularly appealing as they often indicate strong internal confidence and potential resilience in fluctuating market conditions.
